brief:
Netanyahu faces mounting accusations of instrumentalizing Israel's security establishment to preserve his political future, Shehab Wire reported. The allegations emerge amid escalating disputes with the opposition over military decisions and oversight of the interim government's performance.

Tensions between Netanyahu and opposition figures have intensified around questions of how security operations are being conducted and whether decisions reflect military necessity or political calculation. The controversy centers on the government's accountability mechanisms during what is being described as a transition period.
dek: Netanyahu faces mounting accusations of instrumentalizing Israel's security establishment to preserve his political future, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Netanyahu accused of exploiting security apparatus for political survival
